explication: LiteRT is an on-device ML and GenAI runtime. The principal workflow is: an application selects a language API, loads a converted model, creates a compiled model, LiteRT selects CPU/GPU/NPU execution, and returns tensor results. The repository also contains StableHLO-to-TFLite conversion, model and buffer management, profiling, WebGPU caching, and vendor-specific Qualcomm and Samsung integrations. Several API-to-internal edges are inferred from documented responsibilities and filenames; sampled source most directly confirms conversion, buffer, cache, and vendor-loading behavior.
